name: zxm-toolkit-admin
description: 个人工具集合管理平台，基于 Monorepo 架构的全栈应用

scripts.build: yarn workspace admin build && yarn workspace server build && yarn workspace client build
scripts.server-go:build: cd apps/server-go && mkdir -p dist && GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -o dist/server-go-linux-amd64 ./cmd/server && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -o dist/server-go-windows-amd64.exe ./cmd/server && cd dist && zip server-go-linux-amd64.zip server-go-linux-amd64 && zip server-go-windows-amd64.zip server-go-windows-amd64.exe && cd ..
